title: Shoals’ Q3 Revenue Up 44%, Announces Merger with ARRAY Technologies
summary: Shoals Technologies Group, a manufacturer of electrical infrastructure solutions for utility-scale solar, battery storage, and data center power systems, posted revenue of $195.3 million in the third quarter (Q3) of 2026, up 43.8% year over year (YoY) from $135.8 million.
